newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venprecar Q3 net falls 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venprecar Q3 net falls 45 pct.

text.p: Venezuelan iron company Venprecar net profits fell 45 percent in the third quarter to June, to $3.462 million, the company said in a statement.
In the nine months to June, net profits rose 20 percent to $12.9 million on sales worth $61.8 million, 10 percent lower than last year.
In the third quarter to June, sales totalled $22 million, 25 percent below the same time last year.

The company, a subsidiary of Sivensa, said the weaker performance was due to lower prices and a delayed shipment which would take place in July. Hot briquetted iron prices in the third quarter were 8.6 percent below last year, it added.
Venprecar said it had launched an initiative to hike capacity from 715,000 to 800,000 tonnes per year, which would be complete by the beginning of the 1999 tax year.
